# dsh-superlocalmemory
A thin DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) bundle that connects SuperLocalMemory to the harness over stdio MCP.
SuperLocalMemory is a local-first memory layer for AI agents: one memory that any harness speaking M
CP can share. This bundle contains no memory logic. It is one configuration row for DeepSeek Harness
's official MCP client plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) that launches `slm mcp`, so SuperLocal
Memory's tools show up in the harness as `mcp__slm__<tool>`.

## Verify
1. Open **Settings > Plugins > Plugin list**. A `mcp-client` entry with id `memory-superlocalmemory`

should show as Mounted and Enabled.
2. Start a session. Initial discovery is asynchronous, so wait

for the `mcp__slm__...` tools to appear.
3. In one session ask the agent to remember a unique fact,
then in a new session ask it to recall that fact. The harness's own memory guide describes this writ
e, fresh-session recall check.
You can also confirm the server on its own: `slm mcp` should start and wait for MCP messages on stdi
u can also confirm the server on its own: `slm mcp` should start and wait for MCP messages on stdin.
## Changing the command
If `slm` is not on the `PATH` that the harness sees, set `command` to the absolute path of the execu
table (`which slm`).
